solution.text: Shortest wavelength will correspond to maximum energy. As the value of the atomic number <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi><mo>)</mo></math> increases, the magnitude of energy in different energy states gets increased.
